sources.note: Venezuela-only surname ranking (noncontiguous source rank ranges). Source-published Latin spellings and authentic particles retained. Incidence figures and rank are used exclusively to attest national occurrence, never as selection weights. Estimated secondary dataset, not an official census; source-entry quality and redistribution rights require further review.

sources.type: Published 2012 Venezuelan electoral-register surname occurrences, aggregated by state
sources.note: Only aggregate surnames with >=50 nationally summed bearer occurrences were appended, sorted by observed incidence for attestation only. No frequencies, ranks or individual records stored and all selection is uniform. The upstream author notes possible original register transcription errors and splits two surname columns at spaces; no reconstructed compound surnames. Redistribution/license and quality require review.
